instruction: Paste the content from the literacy spreadsheet into the tiered design spreadsheet without changing the template spreadsheet's original formatting.

dim1: Change this code to: The deliverable file is in .xlsx or .xlsm format and can be opened and edited normally.
The delivered workbook retains the three worksheets "Sheet1", "Sheet2", and "Sheet3", with their names, count, and order unchanged.

Write the literacy-theme assignment content only in the designated content area of the template's "Sheet1." Keep Sheet2 and Sheet3 in their original blank state, and do not add, delete, or rename worksheets.
dim2: +5: Column A has a fixed width of 12.75 characters, Column B has a fixed width of 14.63 characters, Column C has a fixed width of 13.13 characters, Column D has a fixed width of 17.38 characters, Column E has a fixed width of 12.25 characters, and Column F has a fixed width of 15.5 characters.

+1: "Sheet1"!A1:F1 title area: Keep it merged and replace the text with "Tiered Assignment for the Literacy Theme 'Vignettes of the Four Seasons'". Use 18 pt SimSun, bold, black, horizontally centered, and vertically centered. Keep the row height at 39 pt; do not adjust the row height or unmerge the cells when pasting the title.

+1: "Sheet1"!A2:F2 basic-information row: Retain the three fields "Class", "Teacher", and "Time" in A2, C2, and E2, respectively. Use 11 pt SimSun, bold, horizontally centered, and vertically centered. Keep the entry areas in !B2, D2, and F2 blank.

+1: "Sheet1"!A3 assignment-overview heading: Retain the text "Assignment Design Overview (learning objectives, question-type descriptions, etc.)". Use 11 pt SimSun, bold, with Wrap Text enabled, horizontally centered, and vertically centered.

+1: "Sheet1"!B3:F3 assignment-overview content: Keep it merged and enter "Tiered Assignment for the Literacy Theme 'Vignettes of the Four Seasons'; the Basic and Advanced sections are required, and the Extension section is optional." Use 11 pt SimSun in regular style. Keep the row height at 68 pt, and display all text in B3:F3 without clipping at the top or bottom.
+1: "Sheet1"!A4:A6 overall tier heading: Keep it merged with the text "Assignment Design Content". Use 14 pt SimSun, bold, horizontally centered, and vertically centered.
+1: "Sheet1"!B4 Basic Tier heading: Retain the text "Basic-Tier Assignment Design". Use 11 pt SimSun, bold, horizontally centered, and vertically centered.

+5: "Sheet1"!C4:F4 Basic Tier content area: Keep it merged and completely enter all 4 questions from the "Basic" section. !C4:F4 Basic Tier Question 1: Include in full "1. Choose the correct pronunciation for each word and mark '√'." as well as the pinyin choices for "morning dew, gentle breeze, light rain, evening glow" and their corresponding parentheses. Basic Tier Question 2: Include in full "2. Read the pinyin and write the words." as well as qīng chén, xiǎo yǔ, hé fēng, huā duǒ, niǎo ér, fēi, and the sentence fill-in content with its corresponding Tianzige practice grids. Question 3: Include in full "3. Can you circle the characters in these words that denote natural scenery?" as well as the three words "morning dew, light rain, evening glow". Basic Tier Question 4: Include in full "4. Match the items." as well as the two groups "morning dew, noon sun, evening glow, night breeze" and "bright, warm, red, gentle". The corresponding cell row height is 250-350 pt.
+1: "Sheet1"!B5 Improvement Tier heading: Retain the text "Improvement-Tier Assignment Design". Use 11 pt SimSun, bold, horizontally centered, and vertically centered.

+5: "Sheet1"!C5:F5 Improvement Tier content area: Keep it merged and completely enter all 3 questions from the "Advanced" section. !C5:F5 Improvement Tier Question 1: Include in full "1. Word chain." and "early morning→(　)→(　)→(　)". !C5:F5 Improvement Tier Question 2: Include in full "2. Follow the example and talk about the picture." as well as "the breeze is gentle, little bird, willow leaves, stream, kite, clouds" and the corresponding images. !C5:F5 Improvement Tier Question 3: Include in full "3. Carefully observe the picture and fill in the blanks." as well as the fill-in context containing 15 Tianzige practice grids and the corresponding image; the cell contains two images, and the cell row height is 350-450 pt.

+1: "Sheet1"!C5:F5 observation image: Place the illustration of mountains, water, and grassland in the table near Improvement Tier Question 3. Keep the image 5.5-5.7 cm wide and 2.7-2.9 cm high, and do not cover the question prompt or fill-in content.
+1: "Sheet1"!B6 Extension Tier heading: Retain the text "Extension-Tier Assignment Design". Use 11 pt SimSun, bold, horizontally centered, and vertically centered.

+5: "Sheet1"!C6:F6 Extension Tier content area: Keep it merged. !C6:F6 Extension Tier Item 1: Include in full "Take a walk with your family in a nearby park or on campus, record three types of natural scenery, and share them when you return to class." !C6:F6 Extension Tier Item 2: Include in full "Collect two words that describe seasons and discuss them with your classmates."
+1: "Sheet1"!A7:A9 feedback heading area: Keep it merged with the text "Assignment Feedback". Use 11 pt SimSun, bold, and vertically centered.

+3: "Sheet1"!B7:F9 feedback content area: Keep it merged and enter "Self-evaluation: Today I completed stars; I have accumulated stars. Please keep it up!" Include horizontal lines after "completed" and "accumulated", and display "Teacher evaluation:" on a new line. Use 11 pt SimSun, black, with Wrap Text enabled; left-align the text or retain its left alignment.
+3: "Sheet1" merged cells: Retain A1:F1, B3:F3, C4:F4, C5:F5, C6:F6, A4:A6, A7:A9, and B7:F9, for a total of 8 merged ranges; do not add or unmerge any merged ranges.
